episodes.title: Crystal Harris on What Really Happened Inside the Playboy Mansion
episodes.description: Trigger Warning: This episode contains discussions of sexual abuse, coercion, exploitation, child sexualization, and other potentially distressing experiences. Listener discretion is advised. Crystal Harris, author, advocate, and widow of Playboy founder Hugh Hefner, spent nearly a decade inside the Playboy Mansion. What was life inside the Playboy Mansion actually like? How did an environment marketed as glamorous and empowering affect the women living within it? And what happens to intimate images when the people depicted no longer have control over where—or how—they're used? In this episode of Consider Before Consuming, Crystal joins us to discuss entering the Playboy world at 21, the control and abuse she says she experienced inside the Mansion, the sexualization of young women and girls, similarities she sees between Playboy and platforms like OnlyFans, and her ongoing fight to protect private images in Hugh Hefner's archives from being digitized. She also shares how her understanding of consent has evolved, her concerns about AI and image ownership, and what healing has looked like as she's worked to reclaim her identity and voice. episodes.title: Expert Explains What Sexual Assault Most Commonly Looks Like
episodes.description:
Is coercion the same as assault? Why do some victims label an experience as 'assault' only after the fact? And what does sexual consent actually look like?

Chanel Contos, founder of Teach Us Consent, explains what experiences of sexual assault are most common and why they're often dismissed or minimized. She also shares why a 'yes' is only valid if 'no' is safe to say, and why expanding our understanding of consent is essential to fighting sexual violence.

Want to hear more from Chanel? Get the full interview on the Consider Before Consuming podcast here: https://youtu.be/SVbruFXI-jI

episodes.title: How I Was Trafficked by Jeffrey Epstein | A Survivor's True Story
episodes.description:
How did Epstein traffic victims? What does grooming look like for sex traffickers? What was Ghislaine Maxwell's role in trafficking women?

Teresa J. Helm, a Jeffrey Epstein trafficking survivor and advocate, shares her story. She explains the grooming process, Ghislaine Maxwell's role in instilling false confidence, the impact of the abuse on her, and what it was like to realize she wasn't the only one.

episodes.title: What Human Trafficking Really Looks Like
episodes.description: Trigger Warning: This episode contains discussions of human trafficking and exploitation. Listener discretion is advised. Preston Goff is the Vice President of Global Communications at The Exodus Road, a global nonprofit organization working to prevent human trafficking, support survivors, and bring traffickers to justice. Preston has spent years working alongside investigators, survivor advocates, and law enforcement around the world. In this conversation, we discuss the connection between pornography consumption and demand for commercial sexual exploitation, how social media is changing the landscape of trafficking, and why prevention is just as important as intervention. What is human trafficking, and does it always involve kidnapping? Is there a connection between pornography and sex trafficking? How are traffickers using social media to recruit victims? Can platforms like OnlyFans contribute to exploitation? Preston helps unpack these questions while exploring why retrafficking happens, how to talk with young people about exploitation without creating shame, and what each of us can do to become part of the solution. episodes.title: Teresa's Story: I Was Trafficked By Jeffrey Epstein || Consider Before Consuming Podcast
episodes.description:
A Conversation with Teresa J. Helm, Jeffrey Epstein Trafficking Survivor And Advocate

Teresa was 22 years-old message therapy student when she was offered the opportunity to work for a high-profile client as a traveling massage therapist. Instead, she ended up being groomed, sexually assaulted, and trafficked by Jeffrey Epstein and his network of exploiters.

During this episode, Teresa shares her experience being a sex trafficking victim of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, how she’s used that experience to help other victims in her position at the National Center of Sexual Exploitation’s Law Center, and how parents and caregivers can recognize the signs of grooming.

Listen to more episodes of Consider Before Consuming at https://considerbeforeconsumingpodcast.com/ or wherever you listen to podcasts.
